_comment: Requirement 30's numbers, mirrored from the TypeScript product layer so the DSP worker
has no hand-written table of its own. `domain/mastering/bounds.ts` is the single
declaration; `domain/quality/threshold-set.ts` holds the initial threshold values.
`test/unit/mastering/registry-parity.test.ts` compares this file against both, in both
directions, so a change on either side that is not mirrored fails `npm test`.
This file lives inside the DSP package so it ships in the wheel. Same arrangement as
`thresholds` are Requirement 34.3 INITIAL values and are defaults only: the product
layer overrides them per call with the set in force, because Requirement 34.4 lets an
operator change them between two runs.
